name: memre
description: Memory-and-deliverable hygiene. Keeps generated files free of process-residue (change annotations, decision narration, TODOs, and mentions of things named only to be excluded), audits auto-memory for records that store a change instead of a current fact, and imports file-based memories into beads. Ships a writing-rule skill, a PostToolUse residue hook, a linter/fixer, and a beads importer.
